messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need a small curated batch for the quantized-7B bring-up. Goal: find failure modes vs float baseline (paraphrase adversarials, tokenizer edge cases, long-prefix truncation). Who can own collection + golden labeling?
jiwon: I can own collection. thinking 800-1k examples across 4 slices: paraphrase adversarial, concat-long-prefix, unusual tokenization (emoji/rtl), and instruction-ambiguity.
noah: Labeling capacity: we have ~200 label-hours this week. If we aim for 1k with 3-way agreement for the golden set, that's ~6-8 hours of labeling time (depending on UI). need to confirm labeler QA steps.
anya: For evals, we'll run deterministic prompts (same seeds) against float and quant to surface hallucination/regression diffs. Please tag each item with "slice:<name>" and add a short rationale. I'll wire up the harness once we have CSV.
jiwon: plan for collection: sample 250 from existing paraphrase bank, 250 synthetic-adversarial via paraphrase-augmenter, 250 long-prefix concatenations (from convo logs), 250 misc tokenizer edgecases pulled from edgecase-bank. I'll run a dedupe pass before labeling.
maria: dedupe rules: exact input text dedupe + normalized whitespace + unicode NFC normalize. For paraphrase-adversarial we also want fuzzy dedupe (edit distance > 10 allowed).
noah: label guidelines (draft): 1) correctness (0/1), 2) severity (low/med/high), 3) failure type tag (hallucination, truncation, tokenization, format). Also capture "expected_short_answer" where applicable. Will spin up a tiny rubric doc.
jiwon: adding sampling SQL for transparency:
```sql
-- sample synthetic adversarial paraphrases
SELECT id, text FROM paraphrase_aug WHERE aug_type='roundtrip' AND score>0.6 LIMIT 250;
```
jiwon: dedupe command I'm going to run locally:
```bash
python scripts/dedupe.py --input samples.csv --key text_norm --fuzzy 0.8 --out deduped.csv
```
labelbot: :robot_face: created curation queue "quant7b_adversarial_2275" with 1000 slots. Added owners: @jiwon, @noah. ETA: queue live in 10m.
anya: Once deduped CSV is ready, drop into /tmp/qa_harness/quant7b/ and ping me. I'll attach the eval config: compare logprobs, exact-match, and hallucination count.
maria: timeline: collection + dedupe by EOD Thu (2275070000-ish), labeling + golden agreement Fri, preliminary evals Fri afternoon. Is that realistic?
noah: workable if labelers start Thur midday. I'll reserve 4 labelers, 2 for gold review.
jiwon: starting collection now, will post progress updates to this thread and upload deduped CSV to the shared drive when ready.
maria: perfect. Also note: include one column "source_context" where applicable so we can reproduce prefix-length issues.
anya: reminder — include the original float model outputs and quant outputs when labeling ambiguous cases (attach small sample). helps triage if it's a prompt-elicited issue vs quantization bitflip.
jiwon: ack, will capture outputs for a random 10% sample during collection.
noah: I'll draft the label rubric and post as a short doc here by EOD.
maria: thanks everyone. tagging @eng-oncall briefly: if any CI infra perf/regression happens when we run parallel evals tomorrow, please hold off scale-ups until we confirm throttles. :hand:
